'''Incomplete Cruxes''', known internally as '''Cruxa''', are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Crude Parasites|Crude]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Incomplete Cruxes spawn when any [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]], [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted]], [[:Category:Ancient Parasites|Ancient]], [[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]], [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure]], or [[:Category:Derived Parasites|Derived]] Parasite dies and performs their [[Remains|exploding]] death while on fire. This has a 50% chance of occurring.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Incomplete Cruxes are Transitional-stage units with Offensive capabilities. 

*Incomplete Cruxes grow into a [[Crux]] between 20 to 60 seconds.
*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Incomplete Cruxes are able to regenerate at about 0.125 health per second.
* Incomplete Cruxes may flee under specific circumstances.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Incomplete Crux, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Incomplete cruxes flee when under half health.
